deadline.value: The engineering PhD deadlines are in split table cells, so none is quoted.

gre_subject.value: Electrical engineering has no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact faculty whose research interests them.
supervisor.quote: we encourage you to contact faculty whose research interests you

funding.value: The vast majority of incoming PhD students are funded by research assistantships.
funding.quote: The vast majority of incoming graduate students are funded by research assistantships

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's is the minimum; the MS is not required but counts toward the PhD credits.
entry_route.quote: Admission for graduate study at Drexel University requires a four-year bachelor's degree

also.quote: An MS degree is not a prerequisite for the PhD degree

app_fee.value: The engineering guidelines do not state an application fee amount.

fee_waiver.value: The College of Engineering offers no fee waivers.

gre_general.value: The College of Engineering treats the GRE General Test as optional for PhD applicants.

english_waiver.value: Only a US institution degree waives the English test; an English-medium degree from India does not.
english_waiver.quote: This requirement will be waived if the applicant graduated from a US institution of higher education.

notes: Engineering school rules: no fee waivers, GRE optional, and the English test is waived only for a US degree.
